name: code-review
description: 代码审查工具包：只读审查子智能体与 /review 命令，支持未提交改动、commit、分支差异与 GitHub PR；多角度审查，逐条复核过滤误报。

description_i18n.en: Code review toolkit: a read-only review subagent plus a /review command, with multi-angle review and per-issue re-verification to filter false positives.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 代码审查工具包：只读审查子智能体与 /review 命令，支持未提交改动、commit、分支差异与 GitHub PR；多角度审查，逐条复核过滤误报。
